production.note: US model years 2016-2020. First: '2016 Lexus GS F Performance Sedan'. Last: Autoblog (Sven Gustafson, 24 April 2020): Lexus will 'discontinue the entire remaining GS lineup, including the 467-horsepower GS F performance sedan, after production there ends in August' (autoblog-gs-discontinued-2020).

displacementL.note: '5.0-liter'. No opened GS F page prints the cc figure; Cars.com lists '5.0 L/303' (cars-com-2016-gs-f).

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive with the Torque Vectoring Differential; inferred from the release ('well beyond that of what a traditional rear-wheel-drive vehicle can offer').

powerHp.note: Quote: "High-revving naturally aspirated 5.0-liter V8 produces 467 Horsepower". Unchanged through 2020 (Autoblog, 2020: 'the 467-horsepower GS F').

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. 2016 GS F sedan, 8-speed automatic (the only configuration). Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 4,034 lbs". Edmunds, '4dr Sedan (5.0L 8cyl 8A)': "Curb weight: 4,034 lbs." (edmunds-2016-gs-f).

sources.title: 2016 Lexus GS F Performance Sedan Offers a Dynamic Ride, Luxurious Comfort for Five
Lexus GS sedan discontinued (Sven Gustafson, 24 April 2020)

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 4,034 lb rests on Cars.com and Edmunds (databases). A Lexus US specification sheet or a major magazine's spec panel would replace it.
